scripts.dev: bun run --cwd api build && concurrently -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "bun run --cwd api dev" "bun run --cwd app dev" "node --watch api/dist/worker.js"
scripts.test: node api/scripts/package-templates.mjs && bun test core/tests api/tests app/tests sandbox/tests
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd api typecheck && bun run --cwd app typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd api build && bun run --cwd app build
